title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Goodwill Waiver on Demurrage Charges
content:
## Scope

A billed party may ask the desk for commercial goodwill on the demurrage charged to a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record. Goodwill of this kind is granted at that request, on the record's demurrage, in the amount the goodwill rules for demurrage produce. Any product whose goodwill percentage stands at 0 grants none. A commercial goodwill waiver goes only onto a record whose status shows invoiced, the same status that a dispute credit requires. Goodwill asked for on a detention line is not governed here; the general commercial goodwill waiver rules alone decide it.

## Granting the waiver: `grant_goodwill_waiver_e03c98b1`

The agent unlocks this hidden desk tool and then invokes it on the customer's behalf; it is not something the customer runs.

**Capability.** One goodwill waiver entry is written on the free-time record, dated the day it is granted, carrying the reason commercial goodwill and pointing at the invoice line it reduces. The balance the billed party owes on the record falls by the amount waived, and the customer can then see the waiver against that invoice line and the reduced balance.

**Parameters.**

1. `dnd_id` — reference of the free-time record that carries the invoice line; text, as found through the free-time record lookup.
2. `customer_id` — customer reference of the billed party; text, as found through the customer profile lookup.
3. `reference_event_id` — the invoice reference of the line being reduced; text, as shown by the account entry lookup or named in the receipt given when that line was booked.
4. `amount_usd` — the sum waived, in US dollars, as a positive number with two decimal places.

**Return.** A granted waiver is confirmed by the sentence "Goodwill waiver <waiver reference> of USD <amount> booked against invoice line <invoice reference> on record <dnd_id>; balance due now USD <balance>.", the balance being the record's remaining amount owed in US dollars to two decimals after the waiver. A response starting with "Error:" signals that the record reference matches no record, in which case nothing has been written.

## Basis Q&A

**Q: Is the goodwill amount something the desk chooses?**
No. The desk grants the amount the demurrage goodwill rules produce, at the billed party's request.

**Q: Does granting goodwill change the record's status?**
The tool changes the balance and adds the waiver entry; it does not itself alter the record's status.
